artifacts.rationale: No Mendelian diseases are caused by loss-of-function variants. GWAS hits are primarily biomarkers (lipids, fatty acids) or have low effect sizes, suggesting no severe safety contraindications.

artifacts.rationale: High LOEUF (0.71) and near-zero pLI (0.0016) indicate LoF is well-tolerated in humans. DepMap data confirms the gene is non-essential for cell viability across 1258 lines.

artifacts.rationale: There are no Mendelian diseases caused by loss of function across 12 categories, and no rare-variant burden signals for out-of-scope traits, suggesting biallelic LoF is likely safe.
